page_title: GET 3-3 PAL | Getafe v Las Palmas 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Jose Campana (Las Palmas) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
90+1' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jaime Mata will be replaced by Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe).
87' Jaime Mata (Getafe) commits a foul and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes immediately signals a free kick.

86' Close! Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) replaces Sandro Ramirez.
85' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Munir El Haddadi will be replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
83' A neat pass is well received by Jaime Mata (Getafe), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
82' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
82' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) and blew his whistle.
80' The attendance for today's match is 7623.
78' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Borja Mayoral and he is replaced by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe).
75' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Javier Munoz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) is shown a yellow card by the referee for dissent.
67' Jaime Mata (Getafe) was probably a bit loose with his words to Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes, who decides to show him a yellow.
67' Substitution. Ilaix Moriba makes way for Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
66' It should have been a goal! Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
63' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
62' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) meets a cross inside the box, but Alvaro Valles wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
60' A yellow card for a tackle by Ilaix Moriba (Getafe). Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Substitution. Alberto Moleiro will be replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
59' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Marvin (Las Palmas) replaces Maximo Perrone.
58' 3 - 3 Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Las Palmas players.
58' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
57' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
56' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Alvaro Valles makes a save. Now Getafe have a corner.
52' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Getafe was in an offside position.
51' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

50' 3 - 2 Goal! Mika Marmol plays in Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 3:2.
49' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) for Jose Angel Carmona.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

45' 3 - 1 Jaime Mata showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom right corner. It's 3:1.
43' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
43' The foul by Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
42' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Valles intercepts the ball.
40' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) trips an opposition player and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes signals a foul. Getafe are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' 2 - 1 An excellent first touch by Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!

33' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
31' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but David Soria easily deals with the threat.
30' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) touches the ball with his hand.
30' A lofted cross from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
28' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
27' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

26' What a poor attempt! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
25' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Mason Greenwood (Getafe).
24' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' The game is interrupted. Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
21' Las Palmas are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
18' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes no option but to blow his whistle.
14' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Diego Rico laid the ball off to Mason Greenwood (Getafe), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
13' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
13' The Getafe players halt their celebrations as referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
11' 1 - 0 Jaime Mata (Getafe) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
11' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.

8' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
7' Today's referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes rightly decides to book Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) for his harsh tackle.
6' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
5' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

3' The opposition back off Mason Greenwood (Getafe), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the right side of the goal corner, but Alvaro Valles denies him with the save.
2' A corner kick by Getafe is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
1' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Getafe will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
